findings.reason: The try/catch around `await ctx.bootSettled` is dead code. `bootSettled` is `Promise.allSettled(bootWork).then(() => undefined)`, and its own contract says it never rejects, so the catch branch (dispose + watchRuntime.close + rethrow) can never run. A plain `await ctx.bootSettled;` would do the same job and would not suggest a failure mode that does not exist. The outer catch already removes the temporary directory.
